# Adoption Requirements Quality Checklist: UA-F07 — Adoption of the existing apps A01 to A04 as experiences

**Purpose**: Unit tests for the requirements of UA-F07: completeness, clarity, consistency, measurability,
lifecycle and failure coverage, privacy and no-advertising constraints, accessibility, the split between
simulator-verifiable and device-only requirements, and traceability to the sources.
**Created**: 2026-11-13
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: The lead evaluated it under the owner's standing delegation (2026-11-13). `[x]` means the
requirements-quality criterion is satisfied, not that implementation work is complete. Items that failed were
corrected in the specification before this file was written; each item names its correction.
